last_episode_to_air.name: A Dream Ball for You!
last_episode_to_air.overview: Navi is really depressed due to losing the Dream Ball. It was really dear to her, as she had been given it by Matiere so that she'd one day use it to catch hold of her dream... Meanwhile, Metamon picks up the Dream Ball Navi dropped on the airship and decides to head off to Miare City all by itself in order to return it to her...! Will Metamon be able to find Navi and return the Dream Ball safe and sound?!

name: Pokémon Horizons

next_episode_to_air.name: Navi's Little Big Adventure!
next_episode_to_air.overview: Navi has got Metamon and become a member of the Rising Volt Tacklers! The upfront and enthusiastic Navi immediately hits it off with the rest of the crew, but just doesn't seem to click with Uruto... Liko suggests the two of them run an errand in the nearby town, but as expected, they end up fighting again! But when Navi goes off on her own, she ends up getting lost?!

overview: Follow Liko and Roy as they unravel the mysteries that surround them and encounter Friede, Captain Pikachu, Amethio, and others during their exciting adventures!

seasons.name: Series 1
seasons.overview: A new adventure is beginning within the wide world of Pokémon! Arriving at Indigo Academy, a little girl named Liko receives her first partner Pokémon, Sprigatito. But she soon finds herself pursued by the Explorers, a mysterious group that's determined to take the pendant necklace she wears. Liko isn't on her own, though, as Friede, Captain Pikachu, and the other Rising Volt Tacklers offer her protection aboard their airship. Meanwhile, a young boy named Roy dreams of becoming a Pokémon Trainer, unaware of the secret hiding within the Ancient Poké Ball he carries. As Liko, Roy, and the Rising Volt Tacklers set sail for new horizons, what kind of discoveries await?
